priorLessonApplied: R04 no fallible metadata read between hardlink and rollback ledger. R05 applies the same principle earlier: every exclusive side-effect including lock creation must already be enclosed by its own failure cleanup.
newLesson: ERROR: a lock can be orphaned before protected transaction starts. ROOT CAUSE: exclusive lock creation and fsync ran before try/finally and post-close identity acquisition could raise. FIX: capture owner inode using os.fstat(open_fd) inside a guarded acquisition; on failure, delete ONLY our inode even with partial bytes. REGRESSION: inject fsync failure RED on original and GREEN after fix plus a successful retry. PREVENTION: register and bound every side effect before any potentially throwing operation; never erase a foreign lock.
